reason: All three slices of monster-melee-attack have landed, through 28c62d0, and the goal's two testable conditions were verified at that commit rather than taken from a worker's report. Condition one: all five arms the hero's own state gates still refuse, at js/mhitu.js:510, :513, :516, :543 and :548. Condition two: `grep -c "unported('mhitm_ad" js/uhitm.js` answers 37, and exactly AD_PHYS and AD_ELEC have a ported arm. Every entry is done (16), cannot-occur (10), no-effect-yet (2) or later (1) with evidence, and missingWorkByOwner is empty. Two limits apply to this file rather than to the code. It was opened at 7d62df5, after the goal's first two slices had already landed 1,651 changed production lines across eight files, measured by `git diff --numstat a9ba71a..a119cd0 -- js/` with the generated js/monsters.js excluded, so its entries were written against reviewed code rather than ahead of it; the 500-line trigger was passed inside slice one alone and the file should have existed then. And its entries treat the thirty-seven unported arms of mhitm_adtyping() as one entry, because the goal's boundary refuses all of them at a single switch, so this file does not record which a recorded session would reach first. One departure from the goal's headline sentence is deliberate: an armed monster's blow does not reach the hero's hit points, because mhitm_ad_phys()'s AT_WEAP block at uhitm.c:4041-4121 refuses. The goal's two testable conditions do not cover it, AGENTS.md defers rare cases the goal does not name, and 98 seeds scanned for the first slice opened with no armed attacker.

boundary.startingCommit: a9ba71a093e6c2192f888083f9d1c36a60ed5050, which is db92431's parent and so the last commit before the goal's first slice
boundary.startingEvent: monmove.c dochug() calls mhitu.c mattacku() for a monster standing where monnear(mtmp, mtmp->mux, mtmp->muy) holds, which js/monmove.js reaches on the monster's own turn inside moveloop.
boundary.endingEvent: The hero's hit points have changed and the status line shows it, or the attack missed and missmu() has printed its line. For a landed blow the boundary runs through hitmu(), mhitm_adtyping() and mdamageu() to disp.botl and the passive counter-attack, ending when mattacku() returns its M_ATTK_ flags to dochug().
boundary.validInputs: Any input sequence that leaves a hostile monster adjacent to the hero at the top of its turn. The recorded cases reach it by walking the hero into a corridor and back so that a sewer rat, a newt or a grid bug closes. Character choices matter only through AC and hit points, which set the to-hit differential and the damage the hero survives.
boundary.observables: The hit or miss message, the hero's hit points and the status line that shows them, the random-number log through find_roll_to_hit()'s rnd(20), hitmu()'s d(damn, damd) and mdamageu()'s arithmetic, and the screen and cursor after disp.botl. The planning clone runs every monster turn twice, so a message printed outside an env.planning-gated operation appears twice and is an observable defect.
boundary.exclusions: Every arm the hero's own state gates: u.uswallow (520-528), u.uundetected (551-660), the S_MIMIC and M_AP_OBJECT hero-mimic blocks (663-706), u.uinvulnerable (743-755) and the summonmu() gate (729-741). Every range2 arm. Inside the NATTK loop, AT_HUGS, AT_ENGL, AT_EXPL, AT_GAZE and AT_MAGC. Inside mhitm_adtyping(), every adtyp but AD_PHYS and AD_ELEC. Inside mhitm_ad_phys(), the AT_WEAP && otmp block at uhitm.c:4041-4121. mhitm_knockback() past its msize test at uhitm.c:5325. passiveum() past `if (!Upolyd)` at 2519. The hero's death, which mdamageu() refuses ahead of done_in_by().

The list is built from mattacku()'s static call tree, so a caller reaching these functions from outside mhitu.c would not appear in it; js/dogmove.js dog_move()'s usteed arm and pet_ranged_attk() are the two such seams and both are named in entries below. sourceReview: mhitu.c mattacku() was read top to bottom over 491-951 at 7d62df5, and every branch it contains is paired above with a js/mhitu.js line, a named refusal, or a recorded reason for an omission. Its call tree was followed into calc_mattacku_vars(), mtrapped_in_pit(), getmattk(), could_seduce(), missmu(), mswings(), mswings_verb(), hitmsg(), magic_negation(), hitmu(), mdamageu() and passiveum(), and across into uhitm.c mhitm_adtyping(), mhitm_ad_elec(), mhitm_ad_phys() and mhitm_knockback(), and into muse.c find_offensive() and mthrowu.c's three lined-up predicates. Random-number order was checked at the three points that draw inside the boundary: AC_VALUE()'s conditional draw, the per-slot rnd(20), and hitmu()'s d(damn, damd), each of which sits below every refusal that could otherwise skip it. Three claims that omit code rather than stop it were re-derived from source rather than accepted: the u_at(gb.bhitpos) test at :782, whose only intervening write at :545 returns on every path out of :547; the NATTK loop's DEADMONSTER guard, which no ported counterattack can trigger; and the SYSOPT_SEDUCE block, dead in this build. Every reachable path inside the boundary is now implemented or refused before it changes state, draws, or prints. The AD_PHYS arm, the last one outstanding when this file was opened, landed at 78a0330; its own AT_WEAP block stays refused at uhitm.c:4041, which is the one place an armed monster's blow stops short of the goal's headline sentence.
